title: Ruth and Naomi
reflectionQuestion: Ruth loved Naomi so much that she would not let her be alone. Who is someone you love that you like to take care of?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (Ruth). Premier kindness/loyalty story; gentle, relational. Ruth 1's deaths of Naomi's husband and sons are named in ONE calm sentence ('they had grown sick and died'), no lingering on grief -- per KID_STORY_PROMPT 3 (name the outcome calmly, do not dwell). Flag bereavement_softened. For a lonely / missing-someone child: Naomi loses everyone, then is carried home by Ruth's loyalty -- routes a 'left alone / sad' kid toward comfort + belonging. Indelible HELD image = old Naomi holding the baby, her sad heart filled with joy (the not-alone spine, feedback_kid_not_alone_thread). 'God' throughout, no Yahweh. VOICE_RUTH_COMFORT (soft, empathetic) -- on-the-nose register fit.

scriptureKeyVerse.text: Ruth said, “Don’t urge me to leave you, and to return from following you, for where you go, I will go; and where you stay, I will stay. Your people will be my people, and your God my God.
